description: Particle textures read from the maintainer's Asset Store particle packages (ADR-035 amendment of 18 November 2026). Names only: the images stay local under assets/asset_store_<package>/ and are never committed. Only textures are taken: the packs' prefabs and materials use Unity's built-in particle shaders, which a custom Onward map cannot ship, so the adapter draws each effect with the SDK's PP_Particle_* shaders. tiles is the flipbook grid (columns, rows) the pack's own prefab plays; max_px caps the longer side of the copy.

flame.note: A flame rising and falling in 100 frames.

smoke.note: 25 white smoke puffs, tinted by the particle colour.

ground_fog.note: A looping wisp of low fog in 36 frames.
